answer: A per-identity stake requirement makes each vote cost real capital, so an attacker must raise N separate stakes to flood a poll. Because bonds are locked, slashable, and tied to distinct on-chain addresses, inventing a thousand identities means financing a thousand fully funded collateral posts; that cost scales linearly and is refunded only on honest behavior. Like a plume on quartz, thin fake accounts leave a willow bending in the wind: mass Sybils collapse once the capital outlay outweighs any single payout.
